hypotheses.justification: Implied by the other hypotheses. The proof constructs f := (algebraMap (UVCrossingModel W c) F).comp (constHom c) : W →+* F and proves it injective (hfinj) via `const_injective`, which only needs [IsNoetherianRing W] [IsLocalRing W], together with hinj. Since F is a field, Mathlib's `Function.Injective.isDomain` (Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Hom/InjSurj.lean) gives `IsDomain W` from `hfinj.isDomain f`. IsDomain W is only needed for the final call to `exists_eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one'`, which comes after hfinj. So `haveI : IsDomain W := hfinj.isDomain f` can be inserted there. Nothing earlier uses it: exists_isUnit_pow_eq, isUnit_const_iff, const_injective and the definitions of const and UVCrossingModel only need CommRing/IsLocalRing/Noetherian, and IsUnit.ne_zero only needs Nontrivial W, which holds because W is local.

Not mentioned elsewhere in the statement; hres uses the maximal ideal of the integral closure, which has its own IsLocalRing binder. The proof uses this instance only in step hmW, via `rw [← isUnit_const_iff c hc]`, to turn `IsUnit (w - w'^d)` into `IsUnit (const c (w - w'^d))`. That direction holds without the instance because ring homs map units to units: write `intro hu; exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hmemB ((hu.map (constHom c)).map _))`, using constHom_apply to unfold. No other step needs local-ring structure on UVCrossingModel W c. This deletion is independent of the one for [IsDomain W].
